simple.meaning: כִּלָּיוֹן (killâyôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “pining , destruction.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: כִּלָּיוֹן (H3631) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 28:65, with occurrences in Deuteronomy, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כִּלָּיוֹן (H3631) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in כִּלָּיוֹן (H3631) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: כִּלָּיוֹן (killâyôwn) / H3631 is traced through Deuteronomy 28:65, Isaiah 10:22 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but Yahweh will give you there a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and pining of soul.

timeline.evidenceText: Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but Yahweh will give you there a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and pining of soul.
For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.
